comment: Experiment for 0.5.0 (files / UPLOAD_FILE), written without access to the site: probe before trusting the outcomes. Run from the directory that holds experiments/ (the dev-docs worktree), so the file path resolves. Known trap on this page: besides the form's own file field there is a drag-and-drop area whose library adds a second, hidden file input to the page; a file put there is shown in the drop area but is not what the Upload button submits, and Upload with the form's field empty answers 500. Run 2026-11-17: at 0.5.1 Jev chose the dropzone's hidden input (both read file "file", the orphan sorted first at 0,0) at 0.99, Upload went with the form's field empty and the run ended server_error, as foreseen; with 0.6.0's orphan rule (8fb6478) the hidden input is not offered beside the form's field, and the run passes: UPLOAD_FILE into the form's field, CLICK Upload, 'File Uploaded!', 4 requests.
goal: Attach the sample file to the form's file field and click Upload, so that the page says 'File Uploaded!' and names the file.
notes: Use the file field of the form beside the Upload button, not the drag-and-drop area below it.

uploaded.when: The page heading says 'File Uploaded!'. The file name 'sample.txt' is shown below the heading.

server_error.note: Upload was clicked with the form's file field empty: the file went to the drag-and-drop input, or nowhere.
